items.title: Croissant Uses Remy AI to Match Luxury Shoppers With New Brands
items.why: Purchase-history matching across brands could suit a card-linked shopping or loyalty partnership pitch.
items.summary_ai: Luxury resale platform Croissant launched Remy, an AI assistant that recommends brands based on what shoppers have bought.
items.take: Purchase-history matching across brands could suit a card-linked shopping or loyalty partnership pitch.
